instruction: Edit the solder-mask and paste-mask rules in the native Altium PCB document `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc`. Save the modified native document as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\mask_rules.PcbDoc`. Requirements: - Keep the global `PasteMaskExpansion` rule scoped to `All` / `All`, but change `Expansion` to `1mil`. - Keep the local `SolderMaskExpansion` rule named `SolderMaskExpansion`, keep its scope as `HasPad('J2-M2')` / `All`, and change `Expansion` to `2mil`. - Both rules must remain enabled. [Software] To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).
